“Carro” ➡️ In Spain a car is a “coche”, and a “carro” is… a baby stroller 🤯

“Jugo” ➡️ Not the juice you’re thinking of… jugo means gravy! If you’re looking for orange juice, ask for “zumo de naranja” 🍊

“Frijoles” ➡️ Beans are a tricky one in Spain! Green beans are “judías” (yes, the same word Jewish women 🤣) and fava & kidney beans are “alubias”.
